title: 第5724章 飞向空中第5723章 不太妙
lines: 主舰航母内的装备，每一层都价值好几十个亿米金，这么多真金白银的宝贝，在一股子噼里啪啦的爆炸声中，化作硝烟冲上苍穹。
主舰那超级防爆的甲板，被掀起了一个又一个凸起。
不得不夸一句，这逐渐航母的材质确实够硬，正常的防爆钢板，早就被炸穿了。
此时此刻，在全世界各个角落，无数人瞪大眼睛，不敢相信自己所看到的这一切。
非洲某地，“天呐，我这是看到了什么，m国的航母大船居然被人给炸了！
太好了，真棒，早就该这么干了，哈哈哈哈哈！”
南美洲某地，“md，哪个混蛋这么大胆子，居然敢把丑国的航母给炸了，绝对不可饶恕，有这本事早干嘛去了！
炸，狠狠的炸，早一点儿把这该死的航母炸了！”
南联盟某地，“不，这要死多少无辜的生命？船舱里一定有很多人，这太悲惨了，可我……可我为什么这么高兴！
信奉的真主，你终于睁开眼了，少那个可恶的国家，披着伪善人皮的禽兽们遭到惩罚！
我只有一个愿望，让那些该死的禽兽都去见鬼吧！”
欧洲某地，“不好，里昂号舰队被炸了，华夏这群猴子真是该死，居然这么胆大妄为，敢挑战吜国，无疑是对我们整个欧洲在挑衅！
华夏这些年发展的太快，他没有足够的钱去制造武器，我们一定要紧跟随吜国大哥的脚步，对华夏进行经济打压！
什么？我们有很多产业是依赖华夏的？那就留下这些依赖的产业，把不依赖的全部砍掉！
对，我们就是这么不要脸，只要能维护我们的利益，管别人怎么看我们！”
亚洲某地，“呜呜……吜国爸爸的航母舰队被炸了，我好心痛，如果吜国爸爸要跟华夏开战，我愿意冲在最前面！
吜国爸爸就算是把我当成一条狗，我愿意在身上捆满炸弹，冲进华夏的地盘！”
亚洲另外一地，“我才是吜国爸爸最忠实的仆人，你这个该死的棒子，敢跟我争，我就炸毁你的首府！
哼，华夏好大的胆子，吜国爸爸一定不会放过你，这一次你要倒大霉了！
海面上，航母主舰第三层船舱内。
轰的一声巨响，一块大铁疙瘩从上面掉下来。
在甲板上砸下一个大坑。
更是将刚刚趴在甲板上的几个大兵砸成肉泥。
这些个大兵被上面传来的爆炸声吓坏了，他们在战场上英勇无敌，那是建立在必胜的信心下，全副武装，攻击平民，或者是武器装备战斗素养比他们低了好几个等级的民兵，就算是一些无辜国家的正规军，在各方面也比他们差上一大截。
可现在他们面对的，是一个根本不知道底细，破坏力超级强，堪比超级大魔王，比如他们在所有战场上遇到的敌人都要强大并且神秘，还不知所踪的一个疯子。
这个该死的疯子，他到底是怎么做到的？一个人几乎要把一艘航母主舰给毁了。
丑国的航母，放眼全世界都是傲视群雄的，是最顶级的那一个，是巅峰不可能被超越的存在。
而现在在这个疯子的连番操作下，变成一团冒烟的废铁，目前还不能算是真正的废铁，但都已经这德行了，也好不到哪儿去。
所有大兵看向掉下来的这一块铁疙瘩，这明显是一个被炸毁的坦克，此刻看起来完全废掉了。
附近几个大兵互相看了一眼，然后一起靠近过去，如果那个华夏疯子在这一摊废铁中，把他的尸体揪出来，就是大功一件。
林昆感觉自己死掉了，眼前一片黑暗，身体如同坠入冰窟一般瑟瑟发抖，周围无形的黑暗如同千斤重的钢板一样，不断挤压着身体，让他喘不过气，感受不到身体。
强大的爆炸力，将主战坦克摧毁，也将身处在坦克内部的他造成重创。
死神似乎就在眼前，那冰冷的死亡镰刀，触碰到他的鼻尖儿，一阵冰锥刺骨的感觉。
这种感觉他太熟悉了，过去在漠北战场上，他曾无数次经历过，但没有哪一次像这次这么强烈。
难道，真的要被死神带走了吗？
林昆手指头动了动，不甘心啊，老子一条命就炸了他两层装备储备，怎么算都亏。
不行，我不能就这么死了。
好歹要再炸他一层，或者干脆将这艘航母给凿沉了。
等以后儿子长大了，站在墓碑前提起自己的时候，可以很骄傲的说一句，“我爸林昆真牛！”
也希望静瑶在得知自己牺牲的消息后，能一边流泪一边说一句，“林昆，你让我感到骄傲！”
小楚楚将来长大以后也能说一句，“我爸爸是个顶天立地的大英雄！”
咣当！
content_en:
Each layer of the equipment in the main ship and aircraft carrier was worth dozens of billions of meters of gold. So many treasures of real gold and silver turned into gunpowder smoke and rushed into the sky amidst the crackling explosions.
The super explosion-proof deck of the main ship was lifted up one after another.
I have to boast that the material of the aircraft carrier is indeed hard enough. Normal explosion-proof steel plates have long been penetrated.
At this moment, in every corner of the world, countless people stare wide-eyed, unable to believe what they are seeing.
Somewhere in Africa, "Oh my God, what did I see? Country M's aircraft carrier was actually bombed!"
Great, great, I should have done this a long time ago, hahahahaha! "
Somewhere in South America, "md, what bastard is so bold that he dares to blow up the ugly country's aircraft carrier? It's absolutely unforgivable. Why would you have done it if you had the ability?"
Explode, explode hard, blow up this damn aircraft carrier earlier! "
Somewhere in Yugoslavia, "No, how many innocent lives will be lost? There must be many people in the cabin. This is so tragic, but I...but why am I so happy!"
Allah, you have finally opened your eyes. In that hateful country, the beasts in hypocritical human skins will be punished!
I have only one wish, let those damn beasts go to hell! "
Somewhere in Europe, "No, the Lyon fleet was bombed. These Chinese monkeys are really damned. They are so bold and dare to challenge the country. They are undoubtedly provoking us as a whole in Europe!"
China has developed too fast in recent years, and it does not have enough money to manufacture weapons. We must follow the footsteps of our eldest brother and suppress China economically!
What? Many of our industries are dependent on China? Then leave these dependent industries and cut off all the non-dependent ones!
Yes, we are so shameless, as long as we can protect our interests, we don’t care what others think of us! "
Somewhere in Asia, "Woooo... Dad's aircraft carrier fleet of Li country was bombed. I am so heartbroken. If Dad of Li country wants to go to war with China, I am willing to be at the front!"
Even if my father treats me like a dog, I am willing to strap bombs on my body and rush into China's territory! "
In another part of Asia, "I am the most loyal servant of Father Li. If you dare to fight with me, you damn stick, I will blow up your capital!"
Humph, Huaxia is so brave, your father in the country will definitely not let you go, you will be in big trouble this time!
Definitely! ! ! "
On the sea, in the third cabin of the aircraft carrier's main ship.
There was a loud bang, and a large iron lump fell from above.
A big hole was made in the deck.
He even smashed several soldiers who had just been lying on the deck into pulp.
These soldiers were frightened by the explosions coming from above. They were brave and invincible on the battlefield. Based on the confidence of victory, they were fully armed and attacked civilians, or militias whose weapons and equipment were several levels lower than them in combat quality. Even the regular armies of some innocent countries were far worse than them in all aspects.
But now they are facing a madman who has no idea about the details, is extremely destructive, and is comparable to a super devil. For example, the enemies they have encountered on all battlefields are more powerful and mysterious, and a madman who is still missing.
This damn madman, how on earth did he do it? One man almost destroyed an aircraft carrier.
The aircraft carrier of the Chou Country stands out from the rest of the world. It is the top one and cannot be surpassed at its pinnacle.
And now, under this madman's repeated operations, it has turned into a ball of smoking scrap metal. It can't be regarded as real scrap metal yet, but it is already this virtuous, and it is not much better.
All the soldiers looked at the fallen piece of iron. It was obviously a bombed tank, and it looked completely useless at the moment.
Several nearby soldiers glanced at each other, and then approached together. If the Chinese madman could pull out his body from this pile of scrap metal, it would be a great achievement.
Lin Kun felt like he was dead. There was darkness in front of him. His body was shivering as if he had fallen into an ice cave. The invisible darkness around him was like a heavy steel plate, constantly squeezing his body, making him breathless and unable to feel his body.
The powerful explosive force destroyed the main battle tank and also caused serious damage to him inside the tank.
Death seemed to be right in front of him. The cold death scythe touched the tip of his nose, giving him a bone-piercing feeling from an ice pick.
He was too familiar with this feeling. He had experienced it countless times on the Mobei battlefield in the past, but never as intensely as this time.
Are you really going to be taken away by death?
Lin Kun moved his fingers. He was unwilling to accept it. I had destroyed two levels of his equipment reserves with just one life. It was a loss no matter what.
No, I can't die like this.
At least we have to blow him up one more layer, or simply scuttle the aircraft carrier.
When my son grows up in the future, when he stands in front of the tombstone and mentions himself, he can proudly say, "My dad Lin Kun is really awesome!"
I also hope that after Jingyao learns the news of her sacrifice, she can cry and say, "Lin Kun, you make me proud!"
When little Chuchu grows up, she will be able to say, "My dad is a great hero!"
Bang!
